versions.statuteQuote: No such late charge shall exceed the lesser of 10 percent of the periodic rent or 10 percent of the remaining balance due and owed by the tenant.
No such late charge shall exceed the lesser of 10 percent of the periodic rent or 10 percent of the remaining balance due and owed by the tenant.

summaryForModel: Late fees are capped at 10% of monthly rent (or 10% of the remaining balance if lower), and a landlord can charge one only if the written lease provides for it.
paraphraseExamples: A late charge of $150 will be assessed on rent received after the 5th.
Tenant shall pay 15% of the monthly installment as a late penalty.
tenantExplanation: Virginia limits late fees to 10% of your rent. A higher fee can't be enforced.
action: You can ask your landlord to change this to 10% or less before you sign.
